A.notes: Clean, coherent sans+mono system; hero phone/ticket moment with 14%->4.2% stat; dark Clinic tier and dark CTA with form give rhythm. Weak spots: empty gap in hero phone, plain Inter display, 7 radii, left-heavy hero. Mobile solid, no overflow; a few touch targets under 44px.

B.notes: More distinctive: Instrument Serif with italic accent, tilted phone with live SMS thread, calendar and bar-chart mockups. But audit fails contrast (3.0:1 on 10px timestamps), focus-visible on two CTAs, and 10-11px text. Hero floating chip clipped behind the phone ('fewer no-sl'), heading skip, 10 radii, amber/lime hues add noise.

why: B has the more distinctive, editorial design (raw 57 vs 55) but fails three hard gates (contrast, focus visibility, min text size) and has a visibly clipped hero chip, so it is capped at 50. A passes all gates and is clean and shippable at both widths.
